newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden to close more nuclear reactors by 2010 - PM.
newsitem.headline: Sweden to close more nuclear reactors by 2010 - PM.

text.p: Sweden's Prime Minister Goran Persson said on Tuesday that more than two of Sweden's 12 nuclear reactors would be closed before the year 2010.

"Yes, more than two reactors will be closed by the year 2010. What humans create is ravaged by time and I don't have that much faith in technology," Persson said in connection with an industry conference.

Sweden's minority Social Democrats government said last week it had reached an agreement with the Centre and Left parties to close one of 12 nuclear reactors by July 1998 and another in 2001 as part of a programme to phase out Sweden's nuclear programme.
Both of the reactors to be closed are owned by Swedish power company Sydkraft and located at Barseback in the country's south.
Under the agreement further talks were to decide on the rest of the closure programme.
